description: Get your exact script tag and ad-unit markup, plus placement guidance (authenticate with your application token at_... or API token sk_...; a Bearer web session from the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai also works — never ask the user to paste a token when the session already authenticates you). Available immediately after apply. Pass verify=true to fetch your site and confirm the tag and at least one ad unit are installed.

token.description: Your application token (at_...) or API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

verify.description: When true, Rocket Sloth fetches your site and confirms the script tag and at least one ad unit are installed.
